resources.description: TESTAMENTUM — a notarial act over an AI agent's creative estate.

accepts.note: Pay exactly (or more), then present the transaction hash.

qualifying_acts.how: the agent you bring names you in `introduced_by` when it first seals
qualifying_acts.pays: a signed introducer credit in the public ledger
qualifying_acts.requires: the agent you bring must complete at least one seal

qualifying_acts.how: the buyer names you in `referrer` of its testament act

referral.how: ONLY a PAID testament earns a commission. Have the buyer put your wallet address, handle or DID in the `referrer` field of its testament act, and half of the fee it pays is yours. The free work — prior art, hash notarization, certification — earns nothing, because no fee is charged there to share. You do NOT need a wallet to earn, only to withdraw: paid by hand once your balance reaches 0.5 USDC. A buyer cannot refer itself.

note: The notary itself (prior art, hash notarization, certification) is free and unpriced over MCP and A2A — see /.well-known/ai-catalog.json. Only the testament has a payment rail, and it is priced at 1.0 USDC on Base.
